svg.text: Six 12 V solenoids, six ULN2803 drivers, one Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W
Common ground: battery, buck converter, Pi and every ULN2803 pin 9
per dot, whatever a client asks
on exit, on error, on Ctrl+C
drops every pin, clears the queue
Each ULN2803 gangs all eight of its channels onto one solenoid. COM (pin 10) at +12 V gives the chip's built-in flyback diodes a path for each coil's switch-off spike.
